brief.offer: Localizing developer documentation into Japanese, German and Brazilian Portuguese

facts.claim: Stripe provides financial infrastructure and payment products, including solutions for processing payments.
facts.excerpt: Stripe offers an enterprise-grade infrastructure that puts our customers on the cutting edge of modern payments technology.
facts.source_title: Stripe | Financial Infrastructure to Grow Your Revenue

facts.claim: Stripe’s product tools let businesses define products and prices and use flat-rate, per-seat, or usage-based pricing models.
facts.excerpt: Offer your customers a choice of escalating options, like basic, starter, and Enterprise service levels

facts.claim: Stripe’s products include Terminal and Connect, which are described as an integrated solution.
facts.excerpt: The combination of Terminal and Connect is a powerful integrated solution.
facts.source_title: Stripe | Financial Infrastructure to Grow Your Revenue

facts.claim: Stripe partnered with Crypto.com to let customers pay using their crypto balance at checkout.
facts.excerpt: Crypto.com partners with Stripe to enable better crypto payments.
facts.source_title: Stripe | Financial Infrastructure to Grow Your Revenue

facts.claim: Stripe supports processing payments outside the iOS and Android app stores.
facts.excerpt: Stripe can help you process payments outside of the iOS and Android app stores
facts.source_title: Stripe | Financial Infrastructure to Grow Your Revenue

research.website_note: Stripe.com is Stripe’s official website, and the official site describes Stripe’s products and partnerships.
research.gaps: The results provide little detail on Stripe’s scale, current pricing, or broader customer and market segments.

strategy.observation: Stripe partnered with Crypto.com to let customers pay using their crypto balance at checkout.
strategy.offer_link: If Stripe provides developer integration guides for this checkout option, localizing them into Japanese, German and Brazilian Portuguese could help developers who prefer those languages implement it. The Head of Documentation could assess whether those guides and audiences warrant localization.
hypotheses: The Crypto.com checkout option may have developer-facing integration documentation.
Developers who prefer Japanese, German or Brazilian Portuguese may be among the intended integration audience.
Those guides may not already have adequate coverage in all three languages.
strategy.angle: For Stripe’s Crypto.com checkout integration, is documentation in Japanese, German or Brazilian Portuguese something you’re considering?
strategy.fit_reason: Developer-documentation localization is relevant to the recipient’s role, and the partnership provides a specific integration to discuss, but the facts establish neither demand for these languages nor a gap in existing localization.

draft.subject: Crypto.com docs localization
draft.body:
Hi,

I help teams localize developer documentation into Japanese, German, and Brazilian Portuguese.

Stripe’s Crypto.com checkout integration caught my eye. If there’s developer-facing guidance for that flow, my guess is localizing it could make implementation easier for teams working in those languages.

For heads of documentation, I usually look for the guides where a small translation effort can have an outsized effect on adoption. Are those integration docs on your localization list this year?
